title: The Axe's Grudge - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Axe's Grudge trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Axe's Grudge phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Drops the Dread Axe. A straight fight with a long wind-up, so it is the cleanest place to practise parrying a heavy.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 31 of 36 on the list - before it Skill Over Strength · after it Scarlet Wraithblade. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
